Priya K: Quick one 0min — the sample-app quickstart lint step is failing for folks using python SDK json_mode, but node users are green. Repro steps below.

Priya K: ```bash
# Node (passes)
npx redwood-cli sample lint samples/onboard.yaml --schema schemas/onboard.json

# Python (fails)
python -m redwood_samplekit lint samples/onboard.yaml --schema schemas/onboard.json --json-mode
```

Owen: can you paste the exact validator error?

Priya K: ```
ValidationError: response.tool_outputs must be an object, got [ { name: 'search' }, { name: 'rerank' } ]
  at validator/_validate.py:87
```

Priya K: Node's validator seems to accept arrays for tool_outputs (it coerces singletons and sometimes promotes array->object). Python jsonschema is strict.

Lina: ugh, onboarding friction again. New hires hit this in the 10-min quickstart and drop off.

Marco: Is this just single-element arrays or multi-element arrays too?

Priya K: multi-element arrays reproduce the error; node silently merges/normalizes in some cases, python doesn't.

Owen: two approaches: 1) change sample-apps to ensure canonical shapes (normalizer pre-lint), 2) add a parity-mode to python lint that applies the same coercions as the node pipeline. Prefer (2) for short-term.

Lina: we should be careful about silent coercions causing downstream surprises though. Docs + an opt-in flag would be safer.

Marco: agree. Could implement a --compat-with-node flag that does a small set of transformations: string->number when numeric string, unwrap single-element arrays, and convert arrays-of-kv to object if items look like {key, value}. Keep it explicit.

Priya K: OK I'll draft a tiny normalizer in samplekit for the quickstart so bootcamp won't be blocked, and we can land the python-flag change in SDK.

Owen: can you add a cross-sdk test matrix? Run node lint and python lint over the same fixture and assert identical normalized output. That'll prevent regressions.

Priya K: yep. Test plan: add fixtures/compat/with-array-tooloutputs.json, run both CLIs with normalization hook, diff canonicalized result.

ci-bot: Branch created: pr/5072 by Priya K 02 files changed https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/5072

Marco: also file an ENG-ML sync. Their validator transforms may need alignment, otherwise we'll keep adding hacks.

Lina: +1. Add a short section in quickstart: "Why lint results may differ across SDKs" and list known coercions.

Priya K: PR description will include the coercion matrix and opt-in flag docs.

Owen: timeline?

Priya K: temporary normalizer in samplekit today, SDK PR for --compat-with-node in 1-2 days, tests same day. Will ping for review.

Marco: thanks. Important to keep onboarding flow smooth.

Priya K: will also add a small note in the release notes so customers know the new flag exists.

Owen: :thumbsup:
